items.title: The pushforward reflects injections and surjections when the target is covered from below
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter sites.tex (Sites and Sheaves)

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that if every object of the target site is covered by images of objects of the source site, then the pushforward reflects injections and surjections (statement lines 10046-10055). The proof is a complete argument in two parts: for injections the covering assumption embeds the values of a sheaf into a product of values on the source site, so injectivity of the pushforward gives injectivity of the map (proof lines 10058-10064); for surjections a section is locally lifted after refining the covering, and the axioms of a site assemble the local lifts (proof lines 10067-10073). The non-formal content is the two verifications. The claim is H2: two written-out arguments with each input named.
